scope: One full authorized R10 guide plus one Original C transfer; no segmentation, processing, retry or canonical edit
text:
I can build something with AI now, get it looking pretty polished, and start thinking I could sell this.
But I can get that far before I know why someone would choose it over what they’re already using.
I’ve got other things I wanna build too, so I want more to go on before I give this one more time.
So I’m building what I call a GTM Engine to help me figure that out. It looks at the code behind what I’ve built, then researches who might need it and what they’re using already.
That helps me work out what to test. I’d still wanna let someone try what I’ve built on something they actually need to do, and see whether they choose it over their usual way.
Maybe I’ve gotta build a bit more to find that out. That’s fine. I don’t have to decide it’s a business just to keep working on it.
And if I just enjoy using it myself, I can leave it at that. It’s okay to have a hobby.
So you guys tell me, what made you decide to turn something you’d built into a business?
